title: Environment Setup and Tooling
description: Setting up the development environment and tools required for React Native development.

quiz.question: Which package manager is commonly used to install React Native CLI?
quiz.explanation: npm (Node Package Manager) is used to install React Native CLI and other JavaScript packages.

quiz.question: What software do you need to install to run React Native apps on Android devices?
quiz.explanation: Android Studio provides the Android SDK and emulator for React Native Android development.

quiz.question: Which tool is used to run React Native apps on iOS simulators?
quiz.explanation: Xcode is Apple's IDE required to run apps on iOS simulators.

quiz.question: What command initializes a new React Native project using React Native CLI?
quiz.explanation: This command uses npx to initialize a new React Native project.

quiz.question: Which editor is highly recommended for React Native development?
quiz.explanation: VS Code is popular for its React Native extensions and debugging tools.

quiz.question: What does Metro Bundler do in React Native?
options: Bundles JavaScript code for the app
quiz.correctAnswer: Bundles JavaScript code for the app
quiz.explanation: Metro Bundler packages the JavaScript code so it can run in the React Native app.

quiz.question: Which environment variable must be set to run Android builds successfully?
quiz.explanation: ANDROID_HOME points to the Android SDK location.

quiz.question: Which of the following is a popular React Native debugging tool?
quiz.explanation: Chrome DevTools can be used to debug React Native JavaScript code.

quiz.question: What command starts the Metro Bundler server?
quiz.explanation: This command launches the Metro Bundler server to serve JavaScript code.

quiz.question: Which tool can be used as an alternative to React Native CLI for easier setup and development?
quiz.explanation: Expo simplifies React Native setup and development with preconfigured tools.
